channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Grant Hill | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Grant Hill from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Grant Hill
item.description:
“I’ve kept in touch with both Grant Hill and Sean Ford, and we met up probably two months ago. But it was more general talks of two summers from now and scheduling, and what that’ll look like. We’ll probably get together in some fashion this summer for a little bit more extended time. I don’t know if we’ll do anything with players, but certainly we’ll meet. “I love the whole process, so of course when we play and compete against teams, there’s players that will come to mind. But I’m not sweating that right now. That’s really for Grant. It’ll be a collaborative effort. But there’s plenty of time for that.”

Erik Spoelstra on Grant Hill, Jan 25, 2026. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: James Dolan on Vince Carter, Grant Hill
item.description:
James Dolan:

“Yeah, a long time ago. I’ve got to even remember… he ended up playing for the Nets. Oh, shoot. Great scorer. It wasn’t Grant Hill. It was a guy out of Toronto—Vince Carter. Vince Carter is a great example. We were going to do the trade. But the medical team came back and told us he had a 90% severed Achilles tendon. They said it would never hold up.”

James Dolan on Vince Carter, Grant Hill, Mar 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ron Harper on LeBron James, Tracy McGrady, Penny Hardaway, Grant Hill
item.description:
When asked if LeBron James belongs in the category of all-around players like Grant Hill, Scottie Pippen, and Penny Hardaway, Harper offered a different perspective.

“Well,I don’t know if LeBron is a better athlete than what Grant Hill and Penny Hardaway was and what Tracy McGrady was,”

Ron Harper on LeBron James, Tracy McGrady, Penny Hardaway, Grant Hill, Mar 7, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Randy Mims on Grant Hill
item.description:
But perhaps Mims will be.

“[Hill] sent me a text message, 'We would love to have you back,'”

Randy Mims on Grant Hill, Jan 24, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Grant Hill
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Grant Hill showing up in his kitchen to formally invite him to Team USA:

“It’s pretty random. I didn’t see that coming. I thought my wife was better than that. She usually warns me or something but she didn’t warn me. It was cool. It was cool to see.”

Jrue Holiday on Grant Hill, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Grant Hill, Bobby Hurley
item.description:
“Everybody knows the Grant Hill, Bobby Hurley story from 92. In 2019, for the last World Cup, the select team came in, kicked our butts, and that’s the whole point. You want to get great talent to come in and challenge you and that’s what the Select team did today.”

Steve Kerr on Grant Hill, Bobby Hurley, Aug 4, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mike Miller on Grant Hill
item.description:
Mike Miller, agent for Paolo Banchero, said that the Rookie of the Year has not decided yet on whether to play for Italbasket or Team USA in the upcoming FIBA Basketball World Cup.

“For a youngster like Paolo it is always good to have different options. He would like to play for both national teams, but he knows very well he can’t do it. So he will have to make a decision but we don’t know when it will be. It could take 2 days or 3 months. At the moment we are not saying yes or no to the possibility of playing in the World Cup, it will never be a choice against one NT or the other. We will get in touch with Italy, we owe it to them. Paolo has had two meeting with Grant Hill for Team USA. He must ponder well the decision that will have an impact on the player’s next 15/20 years”

Mike Miller on Grant Hill, Jun 10, 2023. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill
item.description:
Damian Lillard:

“When I came in the league, like Jason Kidd was starting for the Knicks and Grant Hill and Kurt Thomas and Kenyon Martin…it was real older dudes in the league,”

Damian Lillard on Kenyon Martin, Jason Kidd, Kurt Thomas, Grant Hill, Mar 14, 2023. Source: Uproxx.

item.title: Jim Tanner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Grant Hill
item.description:
“Players like Kevin Durant, LeBron James, and Grant Hill have shown them the way in terms of using their platforms,”

Jim Tanner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Grant Hill, Aug 23, 2022. Source: boardroom.tv.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Grant Hill
item.description:
Stackhouse said there are some similarities between the new roster and the squads of the past.

“Cade is super-skilled and he kind of reminds me of Grant Hill,”

Jerry Stackhouse on Grant Hill, Jul 26, 2022. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Jalen Rose on Grant Hill
item.description:
“I don’t want to get anyone mad at me, but I haven’t been this excited for a Pistons draft pick since Grant Hill,”

Jalen Rose on Grant Hill, Aug 24, 2021. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Larry Bird, Grant Hill
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Cunningham on comparisons to Larry Bird and Grant Hill:

“It’s surreal knowing that they are legends, some of the best guys to ever play the game. I think it gives you more confidence knowing that Weaver is a guy that really knows basketball.”

Cade Cunningham on Larry Bird, Grant Hill, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Grant Hill
item.description:
“He’s very aware. There’s been a lot of conversation. There’ll be plenty more conversation. And it’s not rocket science. It really isn’t. It’s all about relationships, and he’s very good at relationships so I feel very confident in passing this on to Grant Hill.”

Jerry Colangelo on Grant Hill, Jul 21, 2021. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Michael Jordan, Grant Hill
item.description:
“I've seen Shaq do it in Sacramento. I've seen Grant Hill do it in Atlanta. I've seen Jordan do it in Charlotte. If this partnership is going to be anything like my relationship is with Ryan, there are going to be a lot of things that I'll want to be involved in.”

Dwyane Wade on Michael Jordan, Grant Hill, Apr 16, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Grant Hill, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“My one-on-one game was similar to Grant Hill. I could handle it, put it between the legs, do a lot of tricks and all that stuff. (Olajuwon) wouldn’t have been expecting that. He wouldn't have been ready for that. I wanted to be able to showcase a different game.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Grant Hill, Hakeem Olajuwon, May 15, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Chris Paul on Paul Pierce, Chauncey Billups, Grant Hill
item.description:
Paul, 33, told The Undefeated.

“And I have had the opportunity to play with a lot of great vets. I played with Paul Pierce in his last year in the NBA. I played with Grant Hill his last year in the NBA. I also had an opportunity to play with ‘Chaunce’ [Chauncey Billups]. “Some things go unsaid at times. But as a teammate, you pay attention. You see it with your eyes. So, with ‘Ne,’ it’s his work [ethic]. He didn’t play in our first two playoff games, but he was in the gym, in the weight room and taking care of his body. As a young player, you may not take notice or pay attention to it. But for someone like me who wants that longevity and wants to continue to play, I have the utmost respect for him.”

Chris Paul on Paul Pierce, Chauncey Billups, Grant Hill, May 3, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Grant Hill
item.description:
“Grant Hill was — he gave me so much — professionalism can keep you in the league two or three years longer than you’re supposed to,”

Jared Dudley on Grant Hill, Dec 24, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rick Mahorn on Stephen Curry, Grant Hill
item.description:
“Grant would always clown me about playing at ‘Hamster Institute’ and stuff like that, and I said, ‘But I’ll bust your Duke Blue Devil ass every day.’ Then, one day, Charles O’Bannon said, ‘I want some of that,’ and Grant’s eyes got really big. He said, ‘You want some of this?’ Let’s just say that I felt bad for Charles.“Hill was kind of like the first Steph Curry, in the sense that he was a guy who had a lot of opportunities but never complained and competed at a high level. A guy will say, ‘Man, you don’t know how hard it is to get here.’ He knew. He knew how hard it was to be the best and be in that limelight. I love that dude. He’s still soft, but I love that dude.”

Rick Mahorn on Stephen Curry, Grant Hill, Sep 6, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill
item.description:
Goran Dragic on Udonis Haslem continued:

“A lot of guys in this locker room need leadership like UD, especially Hassan [Whiteside]. I think UD can provide that. He's there where usually some guys would not be, in the toughest moments, when you need something, he's there. That's why everybody loves him. I played with a lot of veteran guys who had successful careers — like UD, Steve Nash, Grant Hill, Amare Stoudemire — [and Haslem] is number one in my books as a player and a leader and a friend.”

Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill, May 11, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Ray Allen on Jason Kidd, Grant Hill
item.description:
Ray Allen on career, Hall of Fame class:

“I will say that up to this point in my career and my life and to be where I am, it’s been a magic carpet ride. I remember watching Jason Kidd and wanting to be like Grant Hill. I cut Grant Hill’s hair in Nike camp. He was my counselor.”

Ray Allen on Jason Kidd, Grant Hill, Mar 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Grant Hill
item.description:
Dan McCarney:Manu on Grant Hill's retirement:

“What a career, what a story, what a guy. The classiest guy I played against.”

Manu Ginobili on Grant Hill, Jun 2, 2013. Source: Twitter @danmccarneysaen.

item.title: Steve Nash on Grant Hill
item.description:
Paul Coro:Nash on luring free agent Grant Hill to L.A.:

“I'll do anything I can, if the Lakers are open to that, to make it a reality.”

Steve Nash on Grant Hill, Jul 5, 2012. Source: Twitter.
